unresolved: Low-temperature glazed earthenware is not the same category as lead-glazed earthenware: fahua-qi uses saltpetre (yaxiao) as flux and Song sancai adds red-green pigment over a white glaze before a second low-temperature firing; both colour at low temperature but neither is a single lead-glaze application. The batch keeps 'low-temperature glazed earthenware' as the category and lead glaze as its dominant route

Glaze composition and batch recipes are almost entirely missing: lead-glazed pottery has only 'lead as the salt base'; Tang sancai records copper, iron, cobalt and manganese as colorants; Liao sancai, Song sancai and architectural liuli record no lead content at all. The Song Yingzao Fashi huangdan-luoheshi-tongmo recipe is the only quantitative entry in the six books, and it gives no proportions

Double firing has one temperature band only (biscuit 1000-1100 C, glaze firing 850-950 C, given as 900 C in the 2009 edition); kiln type, heating rate, glaze thickness and yield are not recorded. 'Glaze and body expansion coefficients must match' is stated as a quality condition with no data

Song sancai 'opened the development of Ming-Qing overglaze polychrome' rests on one sentence from Tian Zibing, with production sites limited to Yuxian Bacun and Lushan; the transmission chain to Ming-Qing overglaze polychrome (pigments, firing temperature, application sequence) is not connected in any book, and the mature form belongs to B.6.4

Liuli has two meanings that share one name: architectural lead-glazed earthenware and early glass. This batch takes only the second sense (architecture); the first sense (Warring States liuli bi, lead-barium and sodium-barium glass, Li Lixin's 'rise and fall of glassware') awaits a glass-material Theme, and the boundary between the two senses must be re-examined there

Liao sancai's relation to Tang sancai rests on contrast description only (single yellow-green-white palette, brittle body, rough glaze); none of the three books records its lead content or firing temperature, and no book states whether it directly inherits the Tang double-firing structure

Fahua-qi: the flux is recorded as saltpetre, but body material, firing temperature, glaze recipe and the method of raising the outline ridges are all missing; its craft genealogy relative to liuli and to Jingdezhen porcelain-bodied imitation is not connected

Huangyou-ci-bianhu (yellow-glazed flattened flask): the name says 'porcelain' but body, glaze and firing temperature are unrecorded; this library makes no material determination and uses it only as a Northern Qi transition node with its dance-and-music reliefs

Liuli kiln organisation is recorded for the Ming only (72 Nanjing kilns later moved to Liuliqu village at Mentougou, kaolin bodies, ten standard sizes); kilns, craftsmen and guild organisation before the Yuan are not recorded, and Ren Tang's title 'liuli daizhao' has no office or rank attached

Ren Tang is the only named liuli craftsman in the six books, known from a single passage in Tian Zibing (Yuan Zhida 1, Fenyang liuli daizhao, a signed incense burner in the Palace Museum); the burner and the Yuan sancai-longfeng liuli-glaze censer are listed together as 'outstanding Yuan liuli works', but neither has dimensions or an excavation record

Sancai shuangyu hu (double-fish flask): the only evidence that sancai was regulated is one sentence that it was listed in official funeral rules and allocated by rank; the vessel's shape and dimensions are not recorded, so the regulation cannot be tied to a specific object

Sancai guan (three-colour jar) is deferred as a caption-only entry: one caption line, no body-text treatment, marked for caption verification together with the existing queue (wucai figure washer, enamel chrysanthemum-quail bottle, Tongguan kiln glazed jar, etc.)
notes: 本批新建 1 个 Topic（B.5.4 低温釉陶），挂载 16 个 KU，不新增 Theme。结构设计的三项判断：其一，Topic 不按朝代或品种罗列，而按「低熔点釉这一个物性条件如何生成三条用途线」组织——熔点（铅釉 700—800℃，可薄挂，金属氧化物定色）、二次烧成（素烧 1000—1100℃、釉烧 850—950℃，辽三彩与宋三彩沿用同一结构而第二次烧的对象从釉变成彩）、用途（随葬明器／建筑构件／陈设供器）。其二，「低温釉陶」不等同于「铅釉陶」：法华器以牙硝助熔、宋三彩在白釉上加红绿彩再烧，两者都在低温呈色而都不属铅釉一次挂彩，故以「低温釉陶」作类别名、铅釉陶作其中最主流的一条路线。其三，琉璃一名两义，本批只取第二义（建筑铅釉陶），第一义（原始玻璃与铅钡玻璃）待玻璃材料 Theme 另处挂载。四处边界处置：素三彩归 B.6.4 不因名目相似并入；宋三彩只登记源头、明清釉上五彩归 B.6.4；紫砂陶、宜兴、石湾窑、荣昌与紫砂东陵瓜归 B.5.5；三彩罐只有图注一行、登记图注单条待核；黄釉瓷扁壶器名作瓷而胎釉烧成温度未载，不作材质判定。运行中发现并修复一处与本批知识判断无关的门禁故障：05-outputs/output-registry.yml 登记的「清末设计文献整理报告_1840-1911_2026-10-28」被移出 05-outputs/drafts/ 到仓库根目录，导致 [9/18] build output gallery 报 output_artifact_pattern_empty；核对该文件与 HEAD 中的 drafts 版本逐字节相同后移回原目录（registry 未改），沿用 h25 同一处置。本批不 commit、不 push。
